note: std-a11y-probe-checkout with the page answers played as events. The link lists, focus reads and page texts are the real answers recorded by probe-checkout.gen/record.py from headless Chrome on the Slovenian fixture shop (Tab presses and Enter over CDP, keyDown with text \r; the server log shows only page GETs, nothing was submitted and the Plačaj control was only focused). The stop-list cases prove a control matching the stop patterns is never activated. Regenerate with python3 -I probe-checkout.gen/gen_goldens.py.

cases.id: PROBE_RUN starts the forms probe on the product page, nothing is pressed
the forms probe's answer for this run is kept and the page links are measured; another run's answer is ignored (control)

payload.expression: (() => { const norm = (s) => (s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const sel = (n) => { if (n.id) { return '#' + CSS.escape(n.id); } const p = []; let c = n; while (c && c.nodeType === 1 && c !== document.documentElement) { const par = c.parentElement; const t = c.tagName.toLowerCase(); if (!par) { break; } const k = [...par.children].filter((x) => x.tagName === c.tagName); p.unshift(t + ':nth-of-type(' + (k.indexOf(c) + 1) + ')'); c = par; } return 'html > ' + p.join(' > '); }; const shown = (e) => e.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden'; const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("a[href],button,input[type=submit],input[type=button],[role=button]")).filter((e) => !e.disabled && e.tabIndex >= 0 && shown(e)); const links = els.map((e) => ({ selector: sel(e), text: norm(e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.innerText || e.value || e.getAttribute('title') || ''), href: e.tagName === 'A' ? e.href : '', snippet: e.cloneNode(false).outerHTML })); const frames = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src]')).map((f) => f.src); return JSON.stringify({ links: links, frames: frames }); })()
